findings.condition: An otherwise parsed cold report has process_owner=None or another non-dict; not claimed for the actual pinned artifact.
findings.evidence: owner_facts first requires type(returned) is dict; main catches that error. finally then calls facts.get('process_owner', {}).get(...) three times without guarding the stored value's type.
findings.effect: A secondary AttributeError can prevent summary.json and HIA_CORE48_READBACK from being emitted, replacing the caught primary failure in the caller's terminal trace.
findings.minimal_repair: Derive a safe dictionary projection solely for final summary fields. Preserve the full producer facts and primary error unchanged; never reinterpret malformed producer data as a valid owner.

findings.condition: Failure while copying or validating retained_zip before reader.register completes; not claimed as an actual observed copy failure.
findings.evidence: Initial original ZIP copy is outside pending_writes tracking. Successful registration alone populates materialized. finally always emits complete_originals_are_in_artifact=True.
findings.effect: An incomplete/unregistered original ZIP can be absent from both after-check inventories while the summary unconditionally claims completeness.
findings.minimal_repair: Track retained_zip as pending before opening the output; retire only after complete identity validation. Expose an explicit registered/after-verified flag and keep complete-originals false on partial copy or failed after-check. Keep any partial bytes.

no_confirmed_blocker_in_reviewed_paths: Every regular entry of each directly embedded ZIP is streamed through ZipFile and SHA256/Git length hashing, with canonical names, duplicate rejection and non-symlink ordinary modes.
Lossless-manifest archives require exact member inventory, original byte sizes/SHA/modes, bounded total and exact canonical manifest digest; existing publication receipts are fully correlated.
Missing publication receipts are explicitly reported, not silently treated as present or verified.
Original owner late disk receipt and returned OWNER_UNCONFIRMED_HOLD are both preserved; that branch does not upgrade the original HOLD or assert run_owned augmentation.
For confirmed original owners, request/implementation SHA and unchanged180/3 budgets are checked against the original records.
Already registered originals are independently after-checked per item; one after-check error does not skip subsequent items.
Console omission is all-or-nothing per full original and is recorded; the code does not truncate a JSON and call it complete.
